title: Short-Term Androgen Priming Before COS Using Aromatase Inhibitor and hCG During Early-Follicular-Phase GnRH Antagonist Administration - a Randomized Controlled Trial
brief_summary: We want to investigate if early follicular phase downregulation and androgen priming, by use of GnRH antagonist, aromatase inhibitor and hCG before COH in a short protocol, shows signs of improvement compared to standard short antagonist protocol
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Indication and wish for IVF/ICSI treatment
* Womens age 20-39 years (both inclusive)
* Regular menstrual cycle within normal range
* Body Mass Index: 18-30 kg/m2 (both inclusive)
* Negative pregnancy test before treatment
* A maximum of 3 earlier IVF/ICSI treatments that did not result in pregnancy

Exclusion Criteria:

* serious systemic disease
* Presence of polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS)
* Earlier poor response with less than 4 mature follicles
* Earlier participation in the investigation
